<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>AMES NATIONAL CORPORATION DECLARED CASH DIVIDEND</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">AMES, IOWA &#8211; On May 13, 2026, Ames National Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) declared a cash dividend of $0.24 per common share. The dividend is payable June 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on June 1, 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Ames National Corporation is listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market under the ticker symbol, ATLO. The Company&#8217;s affiliate banks include: First National Bank, Ames, Iowa; Boone Bank &amp; Trust Co., Boone, Iowa; State Bank &amp; Trust Co., Nevada, Iowa; Iowa State Savings Bank, Creston, Iowa; Reliance State Bank, Story City, Iowa; and United Bank &amp; Trust Co., Marshalltown, Iowa. Additional information about the Company can be found at <u>www.amesnational.com</u>.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
